headline: Riverside County's court says in its own release that its public portal is down with no confirmed restoration timeline.
summary: Added 1 Tier 1 source: the Riverside County Superior Court's Nov 18 release (public access portal, reservation system and eCourt services unavailable; e-filing through the vendor's portal unavailable; no confirmed timeline for restoration). c003 now rests on five courts' own notices, with Riverside moved from outlet reports to the court's own words (stays Confirmed). c010 notes Riverside's lack of a timeline (stays Not established). No label changes. Re-read the vendor's Nov 16 and Nov 20 posts (no newer post found) and Kern (still no ETA). San Joaquin County's court says it is working with its vendor to restore its eCourt portal but does not name the vendor, so it is not added. No FBI or CISA statement naming this incident, no CVE, no attribution. Staleness check done: q002, q005, known and checked-not-found updated. Privacy check done: no individuals, spokespeople, reporters, court contacts or handles named.

headline: Marin County's court confirms the vendor asked courts to take portals offline; an Illinois clerk was still restoring on Nov 20.
summary: Added 3 Tier 1 sources: the Marin County Superior Court's portal notice (names the vendor and its advice to suspend ePortal and eDelivery), the Lake County, Illinois Circuit Clerk's Nov 20 notice (still working to restore the portal) and the Washoe County, Nevada court's home page (portal down, no ETA, no cause named). c002 and c003 now cite Marin's own notice (both stay Confirmed). c010 notes Lake County still restoring on Nov 20 (stays Not established). New c020 (Confirmed): Washoe's portal is down; the court does not name the vendor, so no link is drawn. No label changes on existing claims. Re-read the vendor's Nov 16 and Nov 20 posts (no newer post found) and Kern (still no ETA). No FBI or CISA statement naming this incident, no CVE, no attribution. Coverage in GovTech and the California Courts Newsroom is a reprint of the Sacramento Bee story, not independent. Staleness check done: q002, q005, known and timeline updated. Privacy check done: no individuals, spokespeople, reporters, court contacts or handles named.
